prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: pale cyan. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them. Every cutout is matte paper reflecting only the room light, with a plain blank face: coin rims, document faces, screens and vehicle sides carry no lettering, numerals or marks.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons, tape, rubber stamps, string and pins, stencilled arrows, paper bar charts, stacked sheets, grid paper, torn strips, hole-punched tags, paper clips, in cream, black, pale yellow or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture and print dots.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
7. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip: one line, no wider than a third of the frame width, with safe margins, the chip sitting clear of the subjects. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw. When the beat marks a hero number, that number alone may be printed larger, up to half the frame width.
8. Compositions vary in scale from beat to beat: some show one oversized subject filling the frame, some a small subject alone on open ground, some several elements arranged as a diagram.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: pale cyan.
Subjects: a paper bar chart; a torn-paper arrow.
Opens on the threaded string, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The previous chip flips away as the string snaps upright into a paper bar chart; a torn arrow climbs it and holds at the top.
Ends holding on the arrow.
This composition is oversized: one subject fills most of the frame.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "+293% TO $2.0M". This is the hero beat: the number may print larger, up to half the frame width.

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "+293% TO $2.0M". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: No voice, no speech, no dialogue, no lyrics. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects only; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a cinematic, modern editorial paper collage shot, photographed flat from a top-down perspective under soft room light coming from the upper left. The scene opens on <Picture 1>, featuring a pale cyan block-color paper ground. In the upper third of the frame, a cream-colored paper chip with the black sans-serif text "TRACEABILITY" is visible. Below it, a piece of torn white grid paper is pinned with black push-pins and connected by white threaded strings. The camera is a Static Shot throughout. Immediately upon the start of the video, the "TRACEABILITY" chip flips away rapidly with a slight overshoot, disappearing from the frame. Simultaneously, the white strings snap upright and transform through a fast 2D motion design transition into a large, oversized paper bar chart consisting of several matte cream and black rectangular strips. The bar chart fills most of the lower two-thirds of the frame, with each strip casting a small, soft shadow to the bottom right. At 00:01.000, a new headline chip, cream-colored with a black, extra-bold sans-serif typeface, lands cleanly in the upper third of the frame; it reads "+293% TO $2.0M" in a clean, legible, and stable print, with the numbers printed larger to emphasize the hero beat. Simultaneously, a black-and-white halftone photographic cutout of a torn-paper arrow, featuring rough white torn edges, enters the frame quickly. The arrow climbs the bars of the chart with a snappy, stepped motion, finally holding steady at the top of the highest bar. The composition holds this final arrangement for the remaining duration, with the matte paper textures and print dots clearly visible under the consistent lighting.

overall_soundscape: A series of crisp, tactile paper sound effects. A sharp, light paper-slap occurs as the first chip flips away, followed by a rhythmic snapping sound as the strings transform into the bar chart. A final, satisfying thud of a paper cutout landing and a brief sliding sound accompany the arrow's ascent and final stop.
